what_this_is: v0.0.0 ratings run through a 100k Monte Carlo. The June notebook produced single brackets rather than probabilities; this recovers the distribution those ratings imply.

inherited_from_v000.ratings_source: notebook.ipynb cell 26 output, dated 11 June 2026 05:07, before the opening match

from_v1_0_0.tournament_logic: group tables, tiebreakers (Pts, h2h, GD, GF, TCS, FIFA rank), best-third selection, extra time and shootouts
from_v1_0_0.bracket: corrected knockout_slots.csv. v0.0.0 numbered the R32 fixtures differently, so four of the eight R16 ties routed the wrong R32 winners together. The pairings themselves were right; the routing between rounds was not. Preserving that bug would make the comparison worse, not more faithful.
from_v1_0_0.scorelines: sampled per match rather than v0.0.0 modal scorelines

why_sampling: modal scorelines are deterministic and cannot produce a distribution; sampling each match is what turns the frozen ratings into probabilities
